issues.explanation: The current title styles do not match the `typography.h4` design token provided in the reference data. The screenshot also exhibits a thinner font weight for headings (likely 400) compared to the current '600'.
issues.fixedCode:
title: {
    fontSize: 28,
    lineHeight: 40,
    fontWeight: '400',
    color: '#FFFFFF',
    marginBottom: 12,
  },

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The Figma design specifies a very large display size (48px) for the 'One More Step' title. The current code uses the `typography.h1` token, which typically maps to 32-40px in standard themes. Additionally, the title is implemented as two separate Text blocks, whereas Figma uses a single text node with mixed styles. This should be a nested Text component to ensure correct line-height behavior and flow.
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
<Text style={styles.titleWrapper}>
  <Text style={[styles.titleBase, { color: FIGMA.colors.titleGray }]}>One{ '\n' }</Text>
  <Text style={[styles.titleBase, { color: FIGMA.colors.titleAccent }]}>More Step</Text>
</Text>

// Add to styles:
// titleWrapper: { textAlign: 'left' },
// titleBase: { fontSize: 48, lineHeight: 64, letterSpacing: -2, fontFamily: 'PlusJakartaSans-Regular' }

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The content in the Figma screenshot is vertically centered (content height 618px vs screen height 852px implies ~117px top padding). The current implementation uses `paddingTop: insets.top + 16` (~63px), causing the content to sit too high on the screen.

feedback.explanation: The title 'One More Step' is implemented as two separate Text blocks, breaking the reading flow and line height behavior. Figma uses a single text node. The font size should be 48px (h1).
feedback.fixedCode:
<Text style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>
  <Text style={{ ...theme.typography.h1, color: theme.colors.neutral[400] }}>One{'\n'}</Text>
  <Text style={{ ...theme.typography.h1, color: theme.colors.brand[500] }}>More Step</Text>
</Text>
